executive_summary: Order volume and units sold increased compared with the previous period. Sales were led by Urban Bike A, while Folding Bike C showed the strongest percentage increase among the highlighted products. Nordrhein-Westfalen represented the largest share of mapped orders.

key_insights.statement: Orders increased by 9.1% and units sold increased by 10.3% compared with the previous period.
Urban Bike A was the highest-volume product with 24 units sold.
Folding Bike C increased by 62.5% compared with the previous period, the strongest increase among the highlighted products.
Nordrhein-Westfalen accounted for 23.5% of mapped orders, the largest share among the highlighted regions.

items_requiring_attention.statement: City Bike B declined by 10.5% compared with the previous period and may warrant further investigation.

recommended_actions.action: Review stock availability and recent operational conditions for Urban Bike A and Folding Bike C before deciding whether inventory changes are required.
Investigate possible operational, promotional or seasonal factors behind the decline in City Bike B.

caveats.statement: Profitability cannot currently be assessed because trusted profitability metrics are not available.
Geographic mapping coverage is 99.2%, so a small portion of orders is not represented in Bundesland-level analysis.
